title: A rain of stars
summary: Clones, a timer and chance make stars rain. A score counts the points.
done: You saw clones, the timer and the score.

hello.text: In level 2, it rains stars! Click **New** above the blocks to see what changed.

drop.text: Now the function creates a **clone**: a copy of the hidden star. Each clone falls on its own.

appear.text: This block runs for each new clone. These are the blocks of level 1: they just moved.

tick.text: The **timer** Rain rings every second, and each time one more star falls.

catch.text: Caught: the **score** variable grows by 1, we show it, and the clone is deleted.

show.text: [join] sticks a text and a number together: “Score:” then the value of the score.

slow.text: Start **slow motion**: blocks will light up one by one while the game runs.

watch.text: Look: [create a clone of Star] lights up each time the timer rings.
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Well spotted! Stop slow motion to play at normal speed again.

more.text: More rain: one star every 0.5 second.
more.hint: Change the interval of Rain at the start.

wide.text: Make stars fall from edge to edge: from 20 to 340.
wide.hint: It is the random number for x.
